notes.title: Fight with love is out of Early access!
Q&A + Feedback
notes.content:
Basically, I want to ask you to play the game and send here all troubles you were facing, ask some questions and we will make this game better together! 

What does think about art style? 
What will you change in gameplay? 
What bags did you find in the current build?

notes.title: New characters & inventory removal!
notes.content:
[b]New characters[/b]
I added 2 new characters, which you can access after bitting a game. One of them can change the maximum slot count and another one is in the test mode and will be changed radically, for now, it's a poisoned character which is very toxic.

[b]Inventory removed[/b]
This is a major change. Your inventory is gone from now. You can heal only from the cards. This change should make the game more accessible and minimalistic. 

Hope you will like these changes! <3<3<3

notes.title: Fight with love - big update
notes.content:
[b]Major changes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Sentence mechanic[/b]
    Confusing panel replaced by colorful card slots. You can put any card in any slot, but if you'll manage 
    to match the slots conditions (colors) you'll get significant boost.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37399049/056893ed13b7eefe10911b11f6076a2b3d1c84ea.png[/img]
[*][b]Battle tutorials[/b]
    On the start of the first battle in the run you'll get tutorial tool-tips about fight basics and about items. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37399049/f381b4356c1c92ec29b8a4f43e79c6208bdf9ab1.png[/img]
[*][b]Action bosses are optional now[/b]
    You can choose between action sex scenes (boss fight) or card battle sex scenes.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37399049/a4d444be42e36211ad78c3903f78e29948e8b22f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37399049/eb6879625ea4bdbde9b2a6b996d49adb4de83196.jpg[/img]

Small changes: 
[list]
[*] Power mechanic added to the game
[*] Power buffs reworked
[*] New mechanic added - Lovers can add useless cards to the players deck (rare for now)
[*] Card balance slightly reworked.
[*] All lovers start from 1 card on 1 date and scales to 3 cards on 3 date. 
[*] Moon blinks and car wheels rotates in the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Solidarity with Belarus protesters and prisoners
notes.content:
I start this in game event to declare solidarity with Belarus protesters experiencing extremely police brutality, tortures and murders.

I don't live in Belarus, but its a neighboring country and unfortunately I don't see as many support posts and info about ongoing presidential coup as it should be. So I want to draw attention to dictatorship methods of the ex president Lukashenko, you can fight him in Fight with love. 

Also you can read more about Belarus protests on BBC https://www.bbc.com/news/topics/c40rjmqdq78t/belarus

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37399049/80aee35b35dc51892ea97f1e518dd4e3b3185e1c.jpg[/img]

There is a unique background and a new Luka character in this event. 

Free Belarus. Stop tortures! 
Thanks!

notes.title: Fight with love on Steam Game Festival + DEMO update!
notes.content:
Hi, dear lovers! 
Welcome Fight with love on Steam game fest! 

Fight with love is a deck building card game about dating and abusive relationships! 
You can date your lovers - girls, boys, trans people - you choose! 
But the date is not a simple task. You need to fight with cards and manage your communication mechanics, because dating is all about communication. And if you'll succeed in enough dates you'll have wonderful sex in Bossfight scene! 

You can check Fight with love demo for free and don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273940/Fight_with_love__cardgame_datingsim/]Wishlist Fight with love![/url]



<3<3<3
